ATC Vet — QA07BC05 (diosmectite). Profile Smectites are natural mineral clays composed mainly of alumin- ium silicates and include aluminium magnesium silicate (p.2141), bentonite (p.2141), and Fuller’s earth (p.1447). They have adsorbent properties and some, such as dioctahedral smec- tite (diosmectite), have been used in the management of diar- rhoea. They are also used as pharmaceutical excipients and in industry. ◊ References. 1. Szajewska H, et al. Meta-analysis: smectite in the treatment of acute infectious diarrhoea in children. Aliment Pharmacol Ther 2006; 23: 217–27. 2. Yen ZS, Lai MS. Smectite for acute diarrhoea in children. Emerg Med J 2006; 23: 65–6.
